easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Barbed Servitor
description:
Deal damage to Barbed Servitor
Barbed Servitor and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Barbed Servitor trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt to it
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Barbed Servitor.
Repeat from step 2.
